reviews.author: Rohit Malhotra
reviews.title: Best-in-class mileage, exactly as promised
reviews.text: Two years and 28,000 km in, the Swift has not given a single issue. Real-world mileage sits close to 21-22 km/l in city traffic, which is remarkable. Service costs stay predictable at any Maruti workshop.

reviews.author: Ayesha Khan
reviews.title: Great first car, rear seat is tight for tall passengers
reviews.text: Handling in city traffic is superb and parking is effortless. My only complaint is knee room at the back when the front seat is pushed all the way.

spareParts.authorizedServiceNote: Maruti Suzuki runs India's largest service network — over 4,300 outlets including Maruti Service Masters and NEXA workshops.
spareParts.tip: Genuine parts are cheapest through the Maruti Suzuki True Value / MGA portal; independent stores near Karol Bagh (Delhi) and Kirti Nagar typically match OEM pricing for older models.

faqs.q: Is the Swift available with a CNG option?
faqs.a: Yes, Maruti offers a factory-fitted S-CNG kit on select LXI and VXI trims with a claimed mileage of over 30 km/kg.

faqs.q: What is the resale value like after 5 years?
faqs.a: The Swift typically retains 55-60% of its ex-showroom value at the 5-year mark, among the best in the hatchback segment.

reviews.author: Karthik Subramaniam
reviews.title: Spacious cabin, premium NEXA feel
reviews.text: The boot space is genuinely segment-leading and the dashboard doesn't feel like a budget hatch. CVT is smooth for city commutes but slightly lazy on highway overtakes.

spareParts.authorizedServiceNote: Serviced exclusively through NEXA outlets — pricing is on par with regular Maruti Arena service centres.
spareParts.tip: CVT-specific fluid should only be sourced through NEXA — generic CVT fluid can affect long-term smoothness.

faqs.q: Petrol or CVT — which variant makes more sense?
faqs.a: For mostly city driving, the CVT is worth the premium for comfort; for highway-heavy use, the manual returns better real-world mileage.

reviews.author: Neha Verma
reviews.title: Feels like a genuine SUV, not a jacked-up hatch
reviews.text: Ground clearance handles broken roads with ease, and the mild-hybrid AT is refreshingly smooth in bumper-to-bumper traffic. Cabin quality has improved a lot over the older Vitara Brezza.

reviews.author: Suresh Iyer
reviews.title: Great value, road noise at highway speed
reviews.text: For the price, features are excellent — ventilated seats, 360 camera. Cabin insulation could be better above 100 km/h.

spareParts.authorizedServiceNote: Shares its platform and many parts with the Toyota Urban Cruiser, so genuine parts are also stocked at select Toyota outlets at similar pricing.
spareParts.tip: Insist on the mild-hybrid battery being sourced genuine — aftermarket substitutes commonly reduce the idle start-stop benefit.

faqs.q: Does the mild-hybrid system need special maintenance?
faqs.a: No extra maintenance is required beyond regular service intervals; the mild-hybrid battery typically lasts the life of the vehicle under normal use.
